identity.name: Plainday
identity.one_liner: AI task manager for ADHD and messy minds: brain dump in plain English, get back tasks with dates, priorities and lists.

core_jobs: get everything out of my head before I lose it
turn a messy paragraph into tasks I can actually start
decide what to do next without re-reading a long list
stop forgetting things I already wrote down

features.name: AI brain dump
features.does: Takes one messy paragraph, typed or spoken, and returns separate tasks.

features.name: Plain English dates
features.does: Reads 'next Tuesday' or 'end of the month' and sets a real due date.

features.name: Automatic priority grouping
features.does: Groups tasks by priority without the user configuring anything.

features.name: No streaks or guilt mechanics
features.does: Deliberately omits streaks, scores and overdue shaming.

segments.name: Adults with ADHD
segments.description: Diagnosed or self-identified, already tried several task apps and abandoned them.
pains: loses a thought before it reaches a list
opens a task app and closes it without acting
abandons systems that need daily upkeep
feels judged by overdue counts and broken streaks
triggers: missed a deadline they knew about
read about time blindness or executive dysfunction
gave up on a planner app for the third time

segments.name: Messy-minded professionals
segments.description: No diagnosis, but think in paragraphs rather than lists.
pains: notes app full of unsorted text
task list that no longer reflects reality

not_for: people who want a habit tracker
anyone looking for a medical assessment or diagnosis

differentiators.claim: Accepts one messy paragraph and returns many tasks, rather than one task per line.
No setup tax: no projects, labels or configuration before it is useful.
No streaks, scores or overdue shaming.

source.ref: stated by owner, verified against tiimoapp.com
stated by owner, verified against todoist.com

do_not_claim: that Plainday treats, diagnoses or assesses ADHD
outcomes such as guaranteed productivity gains
